integrity: The proof is mathematical; the supplied finite checker is supplementary and does not establish the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Proved only for q>=3, k>=1, and the prefix of the fixed increasing cyclic permutation of length s<q. A binary alternating-prefix specialization is known and not claimed anew; no full priority review or independent certification is asserted.
title: Exact scattered-palindrome spectrum of partial cyclic-permutation powers
